failure_modes.name: 750W hub motor bearing failure
failure_modes.symptoms: Grinding or rumbling from the hub, increased rolling resistance, heat at the axle, or motor stalling under load.
failure_modes.mitigation: Scheduled bearing inspection, regrease or replace sealed bearings at interval, avoid sustained overload, and monitor motor temperature telemetry.

failure_modes.name: 672Wh pack BMS fault
failure_modes.symptoms: Sudden cutoff under throttle, inaccurate range estimate, swollen cells, charger fault, or no power on key-on.
failure_modes.mitigation: BMS health polling, cell delta-V screening, climate-controlled storage, and scheduled pack replacement before cycle-life end.

failure_modes.name: Mechanical disc brake pad wear
failure_modes.component: Mechanical disc brake calipers and pads
failure_modes.symptoms: Increased lever pull, squealing or grinding at the rotor, reduced braking force, or rotor scoring from metal-on-metal contact.
failure_modes.mitigation: Pad-thickness inspection at service, replace pads before limit, true/clean rotors, and adjust cable tension.

failure_modes.name: Chain/drivetrain wear
failure_modes.symptoms: Chain skipping under load, rust or stiff links, excessive drivetrain noise, or poor gear engagement.
failure_modes.mitigation: Regular chain lubrication and tension check, replace stretched chain and worn sprockets, and keep drivetrain clean of grit.

failure_modes.name: Controller water ingress
failure_modes.symptoms: Erratic throttle response, complete loss of motor assist after wet exposure, burnt smell from controller, or corrosion on internal PCB.
failure_modes.mitigation: Seal and relube enclosure gaskets, mount controller away from spray path, dielectric-grease connectors, and replace water-damaged controllers.

failure_modes.name: Tire punctures
failure_modes.symptoms: Sudden pressure loss, visible puncture or embedded debris, ride instability, or repeated flats on the same wheel.
failure_modes.mitigation: Use puncture-resistant tires/tubes, carry roadside repair kit, inspect for embedded debris at service, and maintain correct pressure.
